== Ingredients ==
* 1 large [[Cookbook:Lemon|lemon]], juiced
* 3 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Tahini|tahini]]
* 8 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]] (220 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]]) plain [[Cookbook:yogurt|yogurt]] or soy-based substitute
* 2 tbsp [[Cookbook:Olive oil|olive oil]]
* 3 cloves [[Cookbook:Garlic|garlic]], [[Cookbook:Mince|minced]]

== Procedure ==
# Add lemon juice to bowl or small [[Cookbook:Food Processor|food processor]].
# Add remaining ingredients, and process well to combine.
